title: VERIFIED RAID CLIPS
description: Shared raid clips now include route proof, squad status, loot source, and a tiny anti-fake stamp before the screaming starts in the elevator.
consequence: The highlight reel gets a witness stand.

title: PRIVATE BUILD RECEIPTS
description: Run summaries now keep exact relic math, weird combo ordering, and suspiciously lucky shop rolls visible only to the player unless they choose to publish them.
consequence: The build keeps its diary off the billboard.

title: BORROWED GUESTBOOK PRAISE
description: Home tours now open with cheerful visitor quotes, suspiciously familiar compliments, and a rotating "people love this room" badge before anyone actually visits.

title: ANTI-CHEAT SHARE QUARANTINE
description: Screenshots and squad recaps now wait behind automated integrity review, watermark checks, and a stern upload delay that treats every victory like evidence.
consequence: The screenshot gets detained at customs.
